about: Every Elden Ring / OS system the mashup touches, as one row each. 'covers' names the sheets whose rows depend on the hook. status = how far it has been proven: unverified (written, not run in the real game), coded, verified. on_failure: degrade = log and continue without it; abort = stop the mod cleanly.

rows.system: Rolling log file in %LOCALAPPDATA%/GowRing/logs
rows.notes: Every hook logs its first success/failure; the log is the oracle.

rows.system: Refuse to run unless ER was started by ModEngine2 offline
rows.notes: Aborts if EasyAntiCheat's module is loaded or no ME2 marker; never works around anti-cheat.

rows.system: Wait for CSTask + WorldChrMan + window before touching anything
rows.notes: Singleton scans cached too early give InvalidRva (see field note).

rows.system: Redirect ER0000.sl2 to the mashup's own save file
rows.notes: Players' normal saves are never opened; abort if the detour fails so the real save is not touched.

rows.system: Read main player HP, position, facing, block
rows.notes: Position in block-local Havok space plus the block id (map re-basing happens).

rows.system: Set Kratos' max HP
rows.notes: Write max HP and heal to full on first entry.

rows.system: Keep stamina full (Kratos does not tire)
rows.notes: Stamina written to max every frame.

rows.system: Hide ER's FP bar
rows.notes: FP is unused by Kratos: runics run on cooldowns, not FP.

rows.system: Hide ER's own HUD (HP/FP/stamina bars, boss bar, item slots)
rows.notes: Our overlay replaces them.

rows.system: Read ER action bits and timers for the player
rows.notes: All bindings are in ER action terms.

rows.system: Mask ER actions while our chords fire
rows.notes: Cleared again every frame so a masked action never leaks into the next one.

rows.system: Find vanilla weapon rows by wep_type
rows.notes: No hard-coded row ids; logs which row each template picked.

rows.system: Rewrite carrier weapon rows (damage, scaling off, weight 0, model)
rows.notes: Weight 0, no stat scaling, fixed damage from weapons.base_damage, model id of the template.

rows.system: Scale carrier attack rows by motion value
rows.notes: Only the carrier weapons' own attack rows are touched.

rows.system: Give the four carrier items on first entry
rows.notes: Marker event flag so it runs once per save.

rows.system: Equip Axe/Blades/Spear in right slots 1-3 and the shield in left 1
rows.notes: Only when the equipment differs from the loadout, so the player's later swaps are respected.

rows.system: Observe hits dealt and taken (HP deltas, chr hit events)
rows.notes: Drives rage gain, stun meter and parry detection.

rows.system: List hostile characters near the player with HP/max HP/position
rows.notes: Hostile = different team than the player, alive, within 40 m; sorted by distance.

rows.system: Stagger a stunned enemy
rows.notes: Poise to zero + hit-reaction request.

rows.system: Deal damage to enemies for throws, runics and finishers
rows.notes: Real engine bullets so ER does hits, resistances and kill credit.

rows.system: Move the thrown axe/spears and draw them
rows.notes: Axe has no model in v0.1; drawn as a streak/marker (see STATUS.md).

rows.system: Animation speed during Rage
rows.notes: Restored the frame Rage ends.

rows.system: Over-the-shoulder offset and aim FOV
rows.notes: Eased with camera.smooth_s; skipped while ER shows a cutscene or menu.

rows.system: Draw the HUD over the game
rows.er_type: D3D12 Present hook via hudhook + ImGui
rows.notes: hudhook DX12 hook with ImGui; draws from gowring-core's HUD draw list.

rows.system: Load converted GoW textures/audio from the cache
rows.notes: Missing cache = prepare did not finish; the mod stops and says so (no look-alike art).

rows.system: Play Mimir and sound effects
rows.notes: Mixes decoded WAVs on a worker thread; a failure here must never block the game thread.

rows.system: Mimir subtitles from GoW text
rows.notes: Subtitle text is converted from Ragnarök's own strings; absent text just means no subtitle.

rows.system: Run the rules engine every frame
rows.notes: gowring-core is driven from here through the Host trait.
